title: Habit 5: Seek First to Understand, Then to Be Understood
coreMove: Seek understanding first by diagnosing the other person's frame; advice earns influence only after the listener feels accurately heard.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a complaint may be solved for the wrong problem
a student may quit over a misunderstood plan
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: listen for the student's map before fixing it

exampleSpecs.stakes: a balance dispute may become a trust break
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: reflect the concern before explaining the code

exampleSpecs.stakes: technical advice may miss the singer's fear
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: hear the emotion before correcting technique

exampleSpecs.stakes: a rushed answer may escalate a dispute
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: separate facts from the claimant's felt loss

exampleSpecs.stakes: a return dispute may turn public
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: slow the exchange until the real concern is named
